known.title: Exclude refusal hints from the startable list

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A is being built, B depends on A, and C depends on B.
B cannot start because A has not passed review. However, C's base_not_started refusal supplies `Next: forge task start STORY/B` (src/forge/task.py:26), and _story includes that follow-up command at src/forge/nextstep.py:696. This new helper consequently returns B as startable even though task start B refuses it. Keep refusal follow-up commands out of the admitted offers. The agreement test misses this because it checks one selected part and requires a trailing space, whereas refusal hints end immediately after the item.
